facts.text: I invited Amy Scott, M.Ed., LPC Associate to connect and asked to schedule a quick call about counseling and psychiatric work at Televero Health.
I work at Televero Health and I am recruiting for psychiatry positions that complement Amy Scott’s skills.
I provided a Calendly link for a 30-minute call: https://calendly.com/bailey-baker-1/30min.
Amy Scott, M.Ed., LPC Associate told me she is not a psychiatrist and that she is an LPC Associate.
Amy Scott, M.Ed., LPC Associate is a Women’s Health Specialist at Exact Sciences in Plano, Texas, United States.
I asked to rewrite a message and encourage a referral.
I asked what a LPC Associate is.
I invited Weston Grove, MD, MPH to connect and asked to schedule a quick call about counseling and psychiatric work at Televero Health.
Weston Grove, MD, MPH is a Psychiatry Resident at UT Health Houston in Houston, Texas, United States.
I asked to rewrite a message and request clarification if he qualifies as a psychiatrist or LCSW.
